messages.subject: New windows installer
parts:
Hi all,

Neal Fultz has revamped and updated the Deducer installer for windows.
It should now be more robust, and does not require an internet
connection to run. Please report any install issues as we have limited
systems to test on.


It's currently live on the wiki manual:
http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php?n=Main.WindowsInstallation

Best,
Ian
